summary: Client-side temporary game pause: seconds left (default 2 s). Added and counted down by the per-frame update of ecl::TimeSystem (bg3.exe+0x77EB10), which removes it when the time runs out. Never seen alive. Registry total 4 (client row).

fields.name: TimeLeft
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x77F580 (AllocRaw 4) stores 0x40000000 (2.0f). ecl::TimeSystem update bg3.exe+0x77EB10 (lines ~343-371): `v = *(float*)(storage + i*4) - GameTime.DeltaTime(+8); *(float*)(...) = v; if (old == 0.0 || v < 0.0) remove TemporaryPauseComponent`. The same function calls the creator (FUN_14077f580) when a float it reads elsewhere is non-zero.
